+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.tenant_catalog_ref_owner(p_tbl text, p_id uuid) RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_tbl NOT IN ('produtos','microrganismos','culturas') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_ref_table' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  EXECUTE format('SELECT owner_organization_id FROM public.%I WHERE id = $1 FOR SHARE', p_tbl) INTO v USING p_id;
+  RETURN v;
+END $f$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION platform_private.tenant_catalog_ref_owner(text,uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.tenant_catalog_receipt(p_org uuid, p_key uuid, p_hash text) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v platform_private.tenant_catalog_root_receipts%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_key IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_key_required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws(':','tcr',auth.uid(),p_org,p_key),0));
+  SELECT * INTO v FROM platform_private.tenant_catalog_root_receipts WHERE actor_id=auth.uid() AND organization_id=p_org AND idempotency_key=p_key;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+  IF v.payload_hash <> p_hash THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_idempotency_conflict' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  RETURN v.result || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
+END $f$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION platform_private.tenant_catalog_receipt(uuid,uuid,text) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_catalog_root_save(p_root text, p_id uuid, p_payload jsonb, p_expected_updated_at timestamptz, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_org2 uuid; v_cfg platform_private.tenant_catalog_root_cfg%ROWTYPE;
+  k text; v_hash text; v_rep jsonb; v_cols text[] := '{}'; v_row jsonb; v_prev jsonb; v_parent uuid; v_ref uuid; v_ts timestamptz;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate');
+  SELECT * INTO v_cfg FROM platform_private.tenant_catalog_root_cfg WHERE root = p_root;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_root_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  IF p_payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload) <> 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_payload_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  FOR k IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) LOOP
+    IF NOT k = ANY (v_cfg.allowed) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_field_forbidden:%', k USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+    v_cols := v_cols || k;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF p_id IS NOT NULL AND p_expected_updated_at IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_cas_required' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  v_hash := md5(concat_ws('|', p_root, coalesce(p_id::text,'new'), p_payload::text, coalesce(p_expected_updated_at::text,'')));
+  v_rep := platform_private.tenant_catalog_receipt(v_org, p_idempotency_key, v_hash);
+  IF v_rep IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_rep; END IF;
+  -- referências no payload: mesma empresa (FOR SHARE no pai)
+  FOR k IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(v_cfg.refs) LOOP
+    IF p_payload ? k AND jsonb_typeof(p_payload->k) <> 'null' THEN
+      v_ref := platform_private.tenant_catalog_ref_owner(v_cfg.refs->>k, (p_payload->>k)::uuid);
+      IF v_ref IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_ref_foreign:%', k USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF p_id IS NULL THEN
+    IF v_cfg.kind = 'profile' AND NOT p_payload ? v_cfg.parent_col THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_parent_required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+    FOR k IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(v_cfg.safe_defaults) LOOP
+      IF NOT p_payload ? k THEN p_payload := p_payload || jsonb_build_object(k, v_cfg.safe_defaults->k); v_cols := v_cols || k; END IF;
+    END LOOP;
+    IF v_cfg.kind = 'root' THEN p_payload := p_payload || jsonb_build_object('owner_organization_id', v_org); v_cols := v_cols || 'owner_organization_id'::text; END IF;
+    EXECUTE format('INSERT INTO public.%I (%s) SELECT %s FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::public.%I, $1) r RETURNING to_jsonb(%I.*)',
+      p_root, (SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(c), ',') FROM unnest(v_cols) c),
+      (SELECT string_agg('r.' || quote_ident(c), ',') FROM unnest(v_cols) c), p_root, p_root) INTO v_row USING p_payload;
+  ELSE
+    IF v_cfg.kind = 'profile' AND p_payload ? v_cfg.parent_col THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_parent_immutable' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+    EXECUTE format('SELECT to_jsonb(x.*) FROM public.%I x WHERE x.id = $1 FOR UPDATE', p_root) INTO v_prev USING p_id;
+    IF v_prev IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_not_found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
+    -- reautorização após a espera do lock (troca de empresa/revogação durante a espera nega)
+    v_org2 := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate');
+    IF v_org2 IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_actor_changed' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+    v_parent := CASE WHEN v_cfg.kind = 'root' THEN (v_prev->>'owner_organization_id')::uuid
+                     ELSE platform_private.tenant_catalog_ref_owner(v_cfg.parent_tbl, (v_prev->>v_cfg.parent_col)::uuid) END;
+    IF v_parent IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_not_found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
+    IF (v_prev->>'updated_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    v_ts := greatest(clock_timestamp(), (v_prev->>'updated_at')::timestamptz + interval '1 microsecond');
+    EXECUTE format('UPDATE public.%I x SET %s updated_at = $3 FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::public.%I, $1) r WHERE x.id = $2 RETURNING to_jsonb(x.*)',
+      p_root, coalesce((SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(c) || ' = r.' || quote_ident(c), ', ') || ',' FROM unnest(v_cols) c), ''), p_root)
+      INTO v_row USING p_payload, p_id, v_ts;
+  END IF;
+  v_row := jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'root', p_root, 'id', v_row->>'id', 'updated_at', v_row->>'updated_at',
+                              'organization_id', v_org, 'replayed', false);
+  INSERT INTO platform_private.tenant_catalog_root_receipts VALUES (v_uid, v_org, p_idempotency_key, v_hash, v_row);
+  RETURN v_row;
+EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_duplicate' USING ERRCODE='PT409';
+END $f$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_catalog_root_delete(p_root text, p_id uuid, p_expected_updated_at timestamptz, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_hash text; v_rep jsonb; v_prev jsonb; v_row jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate');
+  IF p_root NOT IN ('microrganismos','culturas','catalogo_volumes') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_root_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  IF p_id IS NULL OR p_expected_updated_at IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_cas_required' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  v_hash := md5(concat_ws('|', 'delete', p_root, p_id::text, p_expected_updated_at::text));
+  v_rep := platform_private.tenant_catalog_receipt(v_org, p_idempotency_key, v_hash);
+  IF v_rep IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_rep; END IF;
+  EXECUTE format('SELECT to_jsonb(x.*) FROM public.%I x WHERE x.id = $1 FOR UPDATE', p_root) INTO v_prev USING p_id;
+  IF v_prev IS NULL OR (v_prev->>'owner_organization_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_not_found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
+  IF platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate') IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_actor_changed' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF (v_prev->>'updated_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  BEGIN
+    EXECUTE format('DELETE FROM public.%I WHERE id = $1', p_root) USING p_id;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN foreign_key_violation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_in_use' USING ERRCODE='PT409';
+  END;
+  v_row := jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'root', p_root, 'id', p_id, 'deleted', true, 'organization_id', v_org, 'replayed', false);
+  INSERT INTO platform_private.tenant_catalog_root_receipts VALUES (v_uid, v_org, p_idempotency_key, v_hash, v_row);
+  RETURN v_row;
+END $f$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_catalog_formulacoes_replace(p_produto_id uuid, p_items jsonb, p_expected_produto_updated_at timestamptz, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_hash text; v_rep jsonb; v_prev public.produtos%ROWTYPE; it jsonb; k text; v_n int := 0; v_ts timestamptz; v_row jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate');
+  IF p_produto_id IS NULL OR p_expected_produto_updated_at IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_cas_required' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  IF p_items IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) > 50 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_payload_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  v_hash := md5(concat_ws('|', 'formulacoes', p_produto_id::text, p_items::text, p_expected_produto_updated_at::text));
+  v_rep := platform_private.tenant_catalog_receipt(v_org, p_idempotency_key, v_hash);
+  IF v_rep IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_rep; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO v_prev FROM public.produtos WHERE id = p_produto_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND OR v_prev.owner_organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_not_found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
+  IF platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate') IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_actor_changed' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF v_prev.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_produto_updated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  FOR it IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) LOOP
+    IF jsonb_typeof(it) <> 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_payload_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+    FOR k IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(it) LOOP
+      IF NOT k = ANY (ARRAY['microrganismo_id','component_insumo_id','concentracao','unidade','volume_ml','proporcao','e_volume_fixo']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_field_forbidden:%', k USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+    END LOOP;
+    IF it ? 'microrganismo_id' AND jsonb_typeof(it->'microrganismo_id') <> 'null'
+       AND platform_private.tenant_catalog_ref_owner('microrganismos', (it->>'microrganismo_id')::uuid) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_ref_foreign:microrganismo_id' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+    IF it ? 'component_insumo_id' AND jsonb_typeof(it->'component_insumo_id') <> 'null'
+       AND platform_private.tenant_catalog_ref_owner('produtos', (it->>'component_insumo_id')::uuid) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_ref_foreign:component_insumo_id' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  DELETE FROM public.formulacoes WHERE produto_id = p_produto_id;
+  INSERT INTO public.formulacoes(produto_id, owner_organization_id, microrganismo_id, component_insumo_id, concentracao, unidade, volume_ml, proporcao, e_volume_fixo)
+    SELECT p_produto_id, v_org, r.microrganismo_id, r.component_insumo_id, r.concentracao, r.unidade, r.volume_ml, r.proporcao, r.e_volume_fixo
+      FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) e, jsonb_populate_record(NULL::public.formulacoes, e.value) r;
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n = ROW_COUNT;
+  v_ts := greatest(clock_timestamp(), v_prev.updated_at + interval '1 microsecond');
+  UPDATE public.produtos SET updated_at = v_ts WHERE id = p_produto_id;
+  v_row := jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'produto_id', p_produto_id, 'items', v_n, 'updated_at', v_ts, 'organization_id', v_org, 'replayed', false);
+  INSERT INTO platform_private.tenant_catalog_root_receipts VALUES (v_uid, v_org, p_idempotency_key, v_hash, v_row);
+  RETURN v_row;
+END $f$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.tenant_catalog_root_save(text,uuid,jsonb,timestamptz,uuid), public.tenant_catalog_root_delete(text,uuid,timestamptz,uuid),
+  public.tenant_catalog_formulacoes_replace(uuid,jsonb,timestamptz,uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.tenant_catalog_root_save(text,uuid,jsonb,timestamptz,uuid), public.tenant_catalog_root_delete(text,uuid,timestamptz,uuid),
+  public.tenant_catalog_formulacoes_replace(uuid,jsonb,timestamptz,uuid) TO authenticated;
+-- escrita direta de cliente fechada (leitura por RLS preservada)
+REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON public.microrganismos, public.culturas, public.catalogo_volumes, public.formulacoes,
+  public.product_technical_profiles, public.microorganism_technical_profiles FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+INSERT INTO platform_private.tenant_catalog_migration_ledger(step, detail) VALUES ('tenant_catalog_crud', jsonb_build_object('roots', 'microrganismos,culturas,catalogo_volumes,product_technical_profiles,microorganism_technical_profiles', 'formulacoes', 'replace_set'));
+CREATE TEMP TABLE tc_guard_post ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT
+  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.accounts_receivable) AS receivables,
+  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_orders WHERE receivable_generated IS TRUE) AS orders_receivable_generated,

+     AND prosrc LIKE '%internal_origin_snapshot%' AND prosrc LIKE '%C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1%') AS guard_bodies;

LOOP
+    IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', r.sig, 'EXECUTE') OR has_function_privilege('anon', r.sig, 'EXECUTE') THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'post:global_function_open:%', r.sig; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tc_triggers t JOIN pg_trigger g ON g.tgname=t.tgname AND g.tgrelid=t.rel::regclass WHERE g.tgenabled <> t.tgenabled)
+    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'post:trigger_state_not_restored'; END IF;

+    'produtos', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.produtos), 'microrganismos', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microrganismos),
+    'culturas', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.culturas), 'guard', (SELECT row_to_json(g) FROM tc_guard_post g)));
+END $post$;

+-- ============================================================================================
+-- 02 — MANUTENÇÃO LIMITADA: descarte da cadeia de TESTE SEM EMPRESA (decisão do proprietário 01/11/2026)
+-- GERADO por build.py a partir de maint_template.sql + pins LIVE do pacote consolidado (não editar o .review).
+-- CANDIDATO .review — NÃO EXECUTADO em banco hospedado. Executar SOMENTE após revisão, como owner das tabelas,
+-- ANTES de 00-pre-global/01-migrate (cujo PRE exige a cadeia ausente).
+--
+-- Escopo fechado (IDs/contagens exatos; qualquer divergência aborta tudo):
+--   raízes: OS 4a5af44d…, programação 8896d700…, lote cd49ce12…, envase bca8a46a…, estoque 000cd77c…, entrega 20d66f88…
+--   filhos: 9 entrega_checklist (por entrega_id), 1 comprovante cee1b253… (gerado, sem arquivo/snapshot),
+--           2 movimentações 619cde9e…/3f40d033…, 1 CQ 51cf7c0c…  => 19 linhas
+-- Garantias:
+--   * uma transação; locks ACCESS EXCLUSIVE nas 11 tabelas antes de qualquer validação;
+--   * sem CASCADE, sem DISABLE TRIGGER ALL, sem session_replication_role, sem GUC/JWT falso;
+--   * apenas 8 gatilhos nominais (pin da definição exata) são suspensos e reabilitados no MESMO TX;
+--     gates de estoque, refresh da esteira, checklist e comprovante permanecem ATIVOS;
+--   * conjunto completo dos {{N_TRIGGERS}} gatilhos das 11 tabelas (nome+tgtype+definição+corpo md5) exatamente o capturado
+--     em 02/11/2026 (captura-manutencao-20261102.json); sem regras; event triggers só se pinados (lista vazia => aborta);
+--   * papel executor em allowlist ({{MAINT_ROLES}}), sem JWT (auth.uid() NULL, claims vazias);
+--   * ordem de locks igual ao gate: singleton cf_user_guards_v1.state FOR UPDATE primeiro, depois as 11 tabelas;
+--   * varredura FK pareada por (tabela,id) do manifesto, alvo FK = id do pai; FK composta ou alvo != id => aborta;
+--   * POST: linhas fora do escopo (11 tabelas + filhas por FK), corpos de funções, ACL/RLS/policies idênticos ao PRE;
+--   * prova antes do COMMIT: catálogo de gatilhos idêntico ao snapshot inicial; nenhum desabilitado;
+--   * repetição: registro concluído + cadeia ausente => nada excluído; ausência sem registro aborta;
+--   * nenhum bypass persistente: só o registro privado de auditoria é criado.
+-- ============================================================================================
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';
+SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '120s';
+
+-- A. pré-voo ANTES de qualquer DDL (CREATE TABLE/ALTER TABLE disparam event triggers)
+DO $pre$
+DECLARE allowed constant text[] := ARRAY[{{MAINT_ROLES_SQL}}]::text[];
+        evt_pins constant jsonb := '{{EVENT_TRIGGER_PINS}}'::jsonb; r record;
+        v_uid text;
+BEGIN
+  IF current_setting('session_replication_role') <> 'origin' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:replication_role_not_origin'; END IF;
+  IF NOT (current_user::text = ANY(allowed)) OR NOT (session_user::text = ANY(allowed)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:role_not_allowlisted:%/%', current_user, session_user; END IF;
+  IF coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true),''),'{}') NOT IN ('{}','null')
+     OR nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true),'') IS NOT NULL
+     OR nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:jwt_context_present'; END IF;
+  IF to_regprocedure('auth.uid()') IS NOT NULL THEN
+    EXECUTE 'SELECT auth.uid()::text' INTO v_uid;
+    IF v_uid IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:auth_uid_not_null'; END IF;
+  END IF;
+  -- event triggers: TODO gatilho de evento não desabilitado precisa coincidir com o pin completo
+  -- (nome, evento, evtenabled, evttags ordenadas/NULL, assinatura da função, md5 do corpo); desconhecido aborta.
+  -- Nunca desativa event triggers: apenas audita a composição revisada.
+  FOR r IN SELECT e.evtname::text AS evtname, e.evtevent::text AS evtevent, e.evtenabled::text AS evtenabled,
+                  CASE WHEN e.evttags IS NULL THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE (SELECT jsonb_agg(t ORDER BY t) FROM unnest(e.evttags) t) END AS tags,
+                  p.proname||'('||pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)||')' AS sig, md5(pg_get_functiondef(e.evtfoid)) AS fmd5
+           FROM pg_event_trigger e JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=e.evtfoid WHERE e.evtenabled <> 'D' LOOP
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(evt_pins) q WHERE q->>'evtname'=r.evtname AND q->>'evtevent'=r.evtevent
+                   AND q->>'evtenabled'=r.evtenabled AND coalesce(q->'evttags','null'::jsonb)=r.tags
+                   AND q->>'function_signature'=r.sig AND q->>'function_md5'=r.fmd5) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:event_trigger_unreviewed:%:%:%:%', r.evtname, r.evtevent, r.evtenabled, r.tags; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF to_regclass('cf_user_guards_v1.state') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:gate_singleton_missing'; END IF;
+END $pre$;
+
+-- B. ordem de locks do gate de estoque: singleton primeiro (espera limitada), depois tabelas
+SELECT 1 FROM cf_user_guards_v1.state WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;
+DO $g$ BEGIN
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks l WHERE l.locktype='transactionid' AND l.pid=pg_backend_pid() AND l.granted) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:gate_singleton_not_locked'; END IF;
+END $g$;

+-- C. registro privado: ACL somente do dono (allowlist); default ACL registrado; qualquer outro beneficiário é revogado e reprovado
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger(
+  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, purge_key text NOT NULL, step text NOT NULL, detail jsonb NOT NULL,
+  at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp());
+DO $r$
+DECLARE allowed constant text[] := ARRAY[{{MAINT_ROLES_SQL}}]::text[]; g record; rl text;
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT ((SELECT pg_get_userbyid(relowner)::text FROM pg_class WHERE oid='platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger'::regclass) = ANY(allowed)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:ledger_owner_not_allowlisted'; END IF;
+  EXECUTE 'REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger FROM PUBLIC';
+  EXECUTE 'REVOKE ALL ON SEQUENCE platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger_id_seq FROM PUBLIC';
+  FOREACH rl IN ARRAY ARRAY['anon','authenticated','service_role'] LOOP
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=rl) THEN
+      EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger FROM %I', rl);
+      EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON SEQUENCE platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger_id_seq FROM %I', rl);
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  FOR g IN SELECT DISTINCT c.oid::regclass::text AS obj, c.relkind, a.grantee FROM pg_class c, aclexplode(c.relacl) a
+            WHERE c.oid IN ('platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger'::regclass,'platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger_id_seq'::regclass)
+              AND a.grantee <> c.relowner LOOP
+    EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON %s %s FROM %s', CASE g.relkind WHEN 'S' THEN 'SEQUENCE' ELSE 'TABLE' END, g.obj,
+                   CASE g.grantee WHEN 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE quote_ident(pg_get_userbyid(g.grantee)) END);
+  END LOOP;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c, aclexplode(c.relacl) a
+              WHERE c.oid IN ('platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger'::regclass,'platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger_id_seq'::regclass)
+                AND a.grantee <> c.relowner) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:ledger_acl_not_owner_only'; END IF;
+  FOREACH rl IN ARRAY ARRAY['anon','authenticated','service_role'] LOOP
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=rl)
+       AND has_table_privilege(rl,'platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger','SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:ledger_privilege_leak:%', rl; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+END $r$;

+LOCK TABLE public.entrega_checklist, public.entrega_comprovantes, public.entrega_termos, public.entregas,
+           public.estoque_movimentacoes, public.estoque_produto, public.envase, public.controle_qualidade,
+           public.lotes, public.programacao_producao, public.ordens_servico IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;

+-- D. auxiliares TEMPORÁRIOS (removidos antes do COMMIT; sem EXECUTE para ninguém além do dono)
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.__maint_rows_digest(p_rel text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v text; v_short text := split_part(p_rel, '.', 2); has_id boolean;
+BEGIN
+  v_short := trim(both '"' from v_short);
+  has_id := EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=p_rel::regclass AND a.attname='id' AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.atttypid='uuid'::regtype);
+  IF has_id THEN
+    EXECUTE format('SELECT md5(coalesce(string_agg(md5(to_jsonb(x)::text), '','' ORDER BY x.id::text), '''')) FROM %s x
+                     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_temp.tc_maint_manifest m WHERE m.rel=$1 AND m.id=x.id)', p_rel) INTO v USING v_short;
+  ELSE
+    EXECUTE format('SELECT md5(coalesce(string_agg(h, '','' ORDER BY h), '''')) FROM (SELECT md5(to_jsonb(x)::text) h FROM %s x) s', p_rel) INTO v;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN v;
+END $f$;
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.__maint_meta_digest(p_tables text[]) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+    'functions', (SELECT md5(string_agg(p.oid::regprocedure::text || ':' || md5(CASE WHEN p.prokind IN ('f','p') THEN pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) ELSE p.prosrc END)
+                                         || ':' || coalesce(p.proacl::text,''), ',' ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text))
+                    FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
+                   WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','platform_private','cf_user_guards_v1','auth') AND p.prokind IN ('f','p')
+                     AND p.proname NOT LIKE '\_\_maint\_%'),
+    'tables', (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(c.relname, jsonb_build_object('acl', coalesce(c.relacl::text,''), 'rls', c.relrowsecurity, 'force', c.relforcerowsecurity,
+                   'policies', (SELECT md5(coalesce(string_agg(pl.polname::text||':'||pl.polcmd::text||':'||pl.polpermissive::text||':'||coalesce(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(pl.polqual,pl.polrelid),'')
+                                ||':'||coalesce(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(pl.polwithcheck,pl.polrelid),''), ',' ORDER BY pl.polname),'')) FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy pl WHERE pl.polrelid=c.oid)))
+                 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname = ANY(p_tables)));
+$f$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION platform_private.__maint_rows_digest(text), platform_private.__maint_meta_digest(text[]) FROM PUBLIC;
+
+DO $maint$
+DECLARE
+  k constant text := 'chain-sem-empresa-20261101';
+  c_os constant uuid := '4a5af44d-ea5a-4810-8b99-ea601fad8547';
+  c_pp constant uuid := '8896d700-5697-4346-9970-c76373cfb232';
+  c_lt constant uuid := 'cd49ce12-9d06-459c-b874-3c8d3a275423';
+  c_ev constant uuid := 'bca8a46a-77a8-435c-ae67-b0ece207d91a';
+  c_ep constant uuid := '000cd77c-506c-4cdf-b2bd-7233aff8efeb';
+  c_en constant uuid := '20d66f88-b3dd-4a6f-93ac-6ecf03c7468d';
+  c_pr constant uuid := 'cee1b253-be2e-4f62-8b56-0ea15d8e4ec6';
+  c_cq constant uuid := '51cf7c0c-be1b-4007-8882-a26a5399a2a0';
+  c_mv constant uuid[] := ARRAY['619cde9e-3199-4b3a-bb35-de4bc2f9132c','3f40d033-36f0-4dc2-bf01-750f10433fb6']::uuid[];
+  scope_tables constant text[] := ARRAY['entrega_checklist','entrega_comprovantes','entrega_termos','entregas','estoque_movimentacoes',
+    'estoque_produto','envase','controle_qualidade','lotes','programacao_producao','ordens_servico'];
+  -- 8 gatilhos suspensos (nomes); definições/funções conferidas pelos pins md5 abaixo
+  susp constant text[] := ARRAY['controle_qualidade|aa_manual_cq_write_fence_v1','controle_qualidade|trg_cq_resultado_imutavel',
+    'estoque_movimentacoes|trg_estoque_mov_append_only','entregas|zz_delivery_mutation_closed','envase|trg_envase_material_imutavel',
+    'estoque_produto|a00_stock_p1_tenant_guard','estoque_produto|trg_estoque_produto_guard','lotes|aa_manual_lot_delete_v1'];
+  c_ck constant uuid[] := ARRAY[{{CHECKLIST_IDS}}]::uuid[];
+  scope_tables_q text[];
+  v_ck uuid[]; v_out_before jsonb; v_out_after jsonb; v_meta_before jsonb; v_meta_after jsonb; v_fk_rels text[]; v_found text[]; v_n bigint; v_present bigint; v_done boolean; v_rows jsonb; v_before jsonb; v_after jsonb;
+  r record; s text; p text[]; v_guard int := 0;
+BEGIN
+  IF current_setting('session_replication_role') <> 'origin' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:replication_role_not_origin'; END IF;
+  scope_tables_q := ARRAY(SELECT 'public.'||quote_ident(x) FROM unnest(scope_tables) x);
+
+  -- 0. idempotência / repetição
+  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ordens_servico WHERE id=c_os)+(SELECT count(*) FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id=c_pp)
+        +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.lotes WHERE id=c_lt)+(SELECT count(*) FROM public.envase WHERE id=c_ev)
+        +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.estoque_produto WHERE id=c_ep)+(SELECT count(*) FROM public.entregas WHERE id=c_en)
+        +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.entrega_comprovantes WHERE id=c_pr)+(SELECT count(*) FROM public.controle_qualidade WHERE id=c_cq)
+        +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.estoque_movimentacoes WHERE id=ANY(c_mv))
+        +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.entrega_checklist WHERE entrega_id=c_en) INTO v_present;
+  v_done := EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger WHERE purge_key=k AND step='committed');
+  IF v_done AND v_present = 0 THEN
+    INSERT INTO platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger(purge_key,step,detail) VALUES (k,'replay_noop',jsonb_build_object('deleted',0));
+    RAISE NOTICE 'maint:already_purged_noop'; RETURN;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_done THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:ledger_committed_but_rows_present:%', v_present; END IF;
+  IF v_present <> 19 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:scope_count_mismatch:expected_19_got_%', v_present; END IF;
+
+  -- 1. callbacks: conjunto EXATO dos {{N_TRIGGERS}} gatilhos capturados (md5 de pg_get_triggerdef e pg_get_functiondef), todos 'O', sem regras
+  CREATE TEMP TABLE tc_maint_trg_pins(rel text, tgname text, tgtype int, tmd5 text, fmd5 text) ON COMMIT DROP;
+  INSERT INTO tc_maint_trg_pins VALUES {{TRIGGER_PINS}};
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
+              WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname=ANY(scope_tables) AND NOT t.tgisinternal
+                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tc_maint_trg_pins p WHERE p.rel=c.relname AND p.tgname=t.tgname)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:trigger_set_drift:unexpected'; END IF;
+  FOR r IN SELECT p.*, t.oid AS toid, t.tgfoid, t.tgenabled, t.tgtype AS live_type FROM tc_maint_trg_pins p
+             LEFT JOIN pg_trigger t ON t.tgrelid=('public.'||p.rel)::regclass AND t.tgname=p.tgname AND NOT t.tgisinternal LOOP
+    IF r.toid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:trigger_set_drift:missing:%.%', r.rel, r.tgname; END IF;
+    IF r.tgenabled <> 'O' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:trigger_not_enabled_before:%.%', r.rel, r.tgname; END IF;
+    IF r.live_type <> r.tgtype THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:trigger_type_drift:%.%', r.rel, r.tgname; END IF;
+    IF md5(pg_get_triggerdef(r.toid)) <> r.tmd5 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:trigger_definition_drift:%.%', r.rel, r.tgname; END IF;
+    IF md5(pg_get_functiondef(r.tgfoid)) <> r.fmd5 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:trigger_function_drift:%.%', r.rel, r.tgname; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_rewrite w JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=w.ev_class JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
+              WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname=ANY(scope_tables) AND w.rulename <> '_RETURN') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:rule_present'; END IF;
+  FOREACH s IN ARRAY susp LOOP p := string_to_array(s, '|');
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tc_maint_trg_pins WHERE rel=p[1] AND tgname=p[2]) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:suspended_not_pinned:%', s; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('rel',t.tgrelid::regclass::text,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'foid',t.tgfoid::regprocedure::text,
+         'type',t.tgtype,'def',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)) ORDER BY t.tgrelid::regclass::text, t.tgname) INTO v_before
+    FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
+   WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname=ANY(scope_tables) AND NOT t.tgisinternal;
+
+  -- 2. revalidação exata de vínculos e estado (sob os locks)
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico WHERE id=c_os AND organization_id IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:os_not_tenantless'; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id=c_pp AND organization_id IS NULL AND ordem_servico_id=c_os) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:programacao_link'; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lotes WHERE id=c_lt AND organization_id IS NULL AND programacao_id=c_pp) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:lote_link'; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.envase WHERE id=c_ev AND lote_id=c_lt AND organization_id IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:envase_link'; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.estoque_produto WHERE id=c_ep AND lote_id=c_lt AND envase_id=c_ev) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:estoque_link'; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.entregas WHERE id=c_en AND organization_id IS NULL AND lote_id=c_lt AND ordem_servico_id=c_os
+                  AND receivable_id IS NULL AND partner_order_id IS NULL AND reentrega_origem_id IS NULL
+                  AND status::text <> 'cancelada' AND coalesce(comprovante_status::text,'') NOT IN ('confirmado','dispensado')) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:entrega_state'; END IF;
+  SELECT array_agg(id ORDER BY id) INTO v_ck FROM public.entrega_checklist WHERE entrega_id=c_en;
+  IF v_ck IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT array_agg(x ORDER BY x) FROM unnest(c_ck) x) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:checklist_set'; END IF;
+  -- impressão digital de CADA uma das 19 linhas (md5(to_jsonb(linha)::text), manifesto LIVE)
+  FOR r IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES {{ROW_PINS}}) m(t, id, fp) LOOP
+    EXECUTE format('SELECT md5(to_jsonb(x)::text) FROM public.%I x WHERE x.id = $1', r.t) INTO s USING r.id::uuid;
+    IF s IS DISTINCT FROM r.fp THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:row_fingerprint_drift:%:%', r.t, r.id; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.entrega_comprovantes WHERE entrega_id=c_en) <> 1
+     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.entrega_comprovantes x WHERE x.id=c_pr AND x.entrega_id=c_en AND x.status::text='gerado'
+                     AND NOT coalesce(x.metadata ? 'comprovante_snapshot_v1', false)
+                     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(x)) e WHERE (e.key LIKE '%path%' OR e.key LIKE '%arquivo%' OR e.key LIKE 'assinatura_digital%') AND e.value IS NOT NULL)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:proof_state'; END IF;
+  IF (SELECT array_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM public.estoque_movimentacoes WHERE lote_id=c_lt OR estoque_produto_id=c_ep)
+     IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT array_agg(x ORDER BY x) FROM unnest(c_mv) x) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:movement_set'; END IF;
+  IF (SELECT array_agg(id) FROM public.controle_qualidade WHERE lote_id=c_lt) IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY[c_cq] THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:quality_set'; END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.entregas WHERE id<>c_en AND (lote_id=c_lt OR ordem_servico_id=c_os OR comprovante_id=c_pr)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:foreign_entrega'; END IF;
+
+  -- 3. manifesto (tabela,id) e varredura FK PAREADA: só é interna a linha filha cujo par (tabela_filha,id) está no manifesto;
+  --    o valor referenciado precisa estar no manifesto DA TABELA-ALVO da FK. FK composta ou alvo != id aborta.
+  CREATE TEMP TABLE tc_maint_manifest(rel text NOT NULL, id uuid NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(rel,id)) ON COMMIT DROP;
+  INSERT INTO tc_maint_manifest VALUES ('ordens_servico',c_os),('programacao_producao',c_pp),('lotes',c_lt),('envase',c_ev),
+    ('estoque_produto',c_ep),('entregas',c_en),('entrega_comprovantes',c_pr),('controle_qualidade',c_cq);
+  INSERT INTO tc_maint_manifest SELECT 'estoque_movimentacoes', x FROM unnest(c_mv) x;
+  INSERT INTO tc_maint_manifest SELECT 'entrega_checklist', x FROM unnest(v_ck) x;
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM tc_maint_manifest) <> 19 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:manifest_size'; END IF;
+  FOR r IN SELECT k2.conname, k2.conrelid, k2.confrelid, cardinality(k2.conkey) AS nk FROM pg_constraint k2
+            WHERE k2.contype='f' AND k2.confrelid IN (SELECT ('public.'||t)::regclass FROM unnest(scope_tables) t) LOOP
+    IF r.nk <> 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:composite_fk_unsupported:%.%', r.conrelid::regclass, r.conname; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  FOR r IN SELECT k2.conname, k2.conrelid::regclass AS rel, cn.nspname AS cns, cc.relname AS crel, pc.relname AS prel, a.attname AS col, pa.attname AS pcol,
+                  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute ia WHERE ia.attrelid=k2.conrelid AND ia.attname='id' AND NOT ia.attisdropped AND ia.atttypid='uuid'::regtype) AS child_has_id
+             FROM pg_constraint k2
+             JOIN pg_class cc ON cc.oid=k2.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace cn ON cn.oid=cc.relnamespace
+             JOIN pg_class pc ON pc.oid=k2.confrelid
+             JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=k2.conrelid AND a.attnum=k2.conkey[1]
+             JOIN pg_attribute pa ON pa.attrelid=k2.confrelid AND pa.attnum=k2.confkey[1]
+            WHERE k2.contype='f' AND k2.confrelid IN (SELECT ('public.'||t)::regclass FROM unnest(scope_tables) t) LOOP
+    IF r.pcol <> 'id' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:fk_target_not_id_unsupported:%.%', r.rel, r.conname; END IF;
+    v_fk_rels := array_append(v_fk_rels, quote_ident(r.cns)||'.'||quote_ident(r.crel));
+    IF r.cns = 'public' AND r.child_has_id THEN
+      EXECUTE format('SELECT count(*) FROM %s x WHERE x.%I IN (SELECT m.id FROM tc_maint_manifest m WHERE m.rel=$1)
+                        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tc_maint_manifest m2 WHERE m2.rel=$2 AND m2.id=x.id)', r.rel, r.col)
+        INTO v_n USING r.prel, r.crel;
+    ELSE
+      EXECUTE format('SELECT count(*) FROM %s x WHERE x.%I IN (SELECT m.id FROM tc_maint_manifest m WHERE m.rel=$1)', r.rel, r.col)
+        INTO v_n USING r.prel;
+    END IF;
+    IF v_n > 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:external_dependency:%.%=%', r.rel, r.col, v_n; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  -- 3b. invariância: impressão digital de TODAS as linhas fora do manifesto (11 tabelas + filhas por FK) e metadados
+  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(rel, h) INTO v_out_before FROM (
+    SELECT q.rel, platform_private.__maint_rows_digest(q.rel) AS h FROM (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(scope_tables_q || v_fk_rels) rel) q) z;
+  v_meta_before := platform_private.__maint_meta_digest(scope_tables);
+
+  -- 4. snapshot integral das 19 linhas
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+    'checklist',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM public.entrega_checklist x WHERE x.entrega_id=c_en),
+    'comprovante',(SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM public.entrega_comprovantes x WHERE x.id=c_pr),
+    'entrega',(SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM public.entregas x WHERE x.id=c_en),
+    'movimentacoes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM public.estoque_movimentacoes x WHERE x.id=ANY(c_mv)),
+    'estoque',(SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM public.estoque_produto x WHERE x.id=c_ep),
+    'envase',(SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM public.envase x WHERE x.id=c_ev),
+    'cq',(SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM public.controle_qualidade x WHERE x.id=c_cq),
+    'lote',(SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM public.lotes x WHERE x.id=c_lt),
+    'programacao',(SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM public.programacao_producao x WHERE x.id=c_pp),
+    'os',(SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM public.ordens_servico x WHERE x.id=c_os)) INTO v_rows;
+  INSERT INTO platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger(purge_key,step,detail)
+  VALUES (k,'pre',jsonb_build_object('rows',v_rows,'triggers_before',v_before,'out_of_scope_digest',v_out_before,'meta_digest',v_meta_before,
+          'event_triggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',evtname,'event',evtevent)),'[]') FROM pg_event_trigger WHERE evtenabled<>'D'),
+          'default_acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ns',defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text,'type',defaclobjtype,'acl',defaclacl::text)),'[]')
+                           FROM pg_default_acl WHERE defaclnamespace IN (0,'platform_private'::regnamespace)),
+          'executor',jsonb_build_object('current_user',current_user,'session_user',session_user)));
+
+  -- 5. suspensão nominal (somente os 8 gatilhos pinados; mesma transação, sob ACCESS EXCLUSIVE)
+  FOREACH s IN ARRAY susp LOOP p := string_to_array(s,'|');
+    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I DISABLE TRIGGER %I', p[1], p[2]); END LOOP;
+
+  -- 6. exclusões por ID exato, filhos primeiro; cada uma confere a contagem afetada
+  DELETE FROM public.entrega_checklist WHERE id=ANY(v_ck) AND entrega_id=c_en; GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n=ROW_COUNT; IF v_n<>9 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:del_checklist:%',v_n; END IF;
+  -- comprovante + entrega no MESMO comando: as ações FK (SET NULL entregas.comprovante_id / checagem entrega_id) rodam
+  -- ao fim do comando, quando a entrega já não existe => nenhum gatilho de UPDATE de entregas é disparado
+  WITH dp AS (DELETE FROM public.entrega_comprovantes WHERE id=c_pr AND entrega_id=c_en RETURNING 1),
+       de AS (DELETE FROM public.entregas WHERE id=c_en RETURNING 1)
+  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM dp)*10 + (SELECT count(*) FROM de) INTO v_n;
+  IF v_n <> 11 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:del_proof_entrega:%', v_n; END IF;
+  WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.estoque_movimentacoes WHERE id=ANY(c_mv)) LOOP
+    v_guard := v_guard + 1; IF v_guard > 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:movement_cycle'; END IF;
+    DELETE FROM public.estoque_movimentacoes m WHERE m.id=ANY(c_mv)
+       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.estoque_movimentacoes o WHERE o.movimentacao_origem_id=m.id AND o.id<>m.id);
+  END LOOP;
+  DELETE FROM public.estoque_produto WHERE id=c_ep; GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n=ROW_COUNT; IF v_n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:del_estoque'; END IF;
+  DELETE FROM public.envase WHERE id=c_ev; GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n=ROW_COUNT; IF v_n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:del_envase'; END IF;
+  DELETE FROM public.controle_qualidade WHERE id=c_cq; GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n=ROW_COUNT; IF v_n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:del_cq'; END IF;
+  DELETE FROM public.lotes WHERE id=c_lt; GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n=ROW_COUNT; IF v_n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:del_lote'; END IF;
+  DELETE FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id=c_pp; GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n=ROW_COUNT; IF v_n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:del_programacao'; END IF;
+  DELETE FROM public.ordens_servico WHERE id=c_os; GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n=ROW_COUNT; IF v_n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'maint:del_os'; END IF;
+
+  -- 7. restauração e prova antes do COMMIT
+  FOREACH s IN ARRAY susp LOOP p := string_to_array(s,'|');
+    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I ENABLE TRIGGER %I', p[1], p[2]); END LOOP;
+  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('rel',t.tgrelid::regclass::text,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'foid',t.tgfoid::regprocedure::text,
+         'type',t.tgtype,'def',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)) ORDER BY t.tgrelid::regclass::text, t.tgname) INTO v_after
+    FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
+   WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname=ANY(scope_tables) AND NOT t.tgisinternal;
+  IF v_after IS DISTINCT FROM v_before THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'post:trigger_catalog_not_restored'; END IF;
+  IF current_setting('session_replication_role') <> 'origin' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'post:replication_role'; END IF;
+  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ordens_servico WHERE id=c_os)+(SELECT count(*) FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id=c_pp)
+        +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.lotes WHERE id=c_lt)+(SELECT count(*) FROM public.envase WHERE id=c_ev)
+        +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.estoque_produto WHERE id=c_ep)+(SELECT count(*) FROM public.entregas WHERE id=c_en)
+        +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.entrega_comprovantes WHERE id=c_pr)+(SELECT count(*) FROM public.controle_qualidade WHERE id=c_cq)
+        +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.estoque_movimentacoes WHERE id=ANY(c_mv))
+        +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.entrega_checklist WHERE id=ANY(v_ck)) INTO v_present;
+  IF v_present <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'post:rows_remaining:%', v_present; END IF;
+  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(rel, h) INTO v_out_after FROM (
+    SELECT q.rel, platform_private.__maint_rows_digest(q.rel) AS h FROM (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(scope_tables_q || v_fk_rels) rel) q) z;
+  IF v_out_after IS DISTINCT FROM v_out_before THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'post:out_of_scope_rows_changed'; END IF;
+  v_meta_after := platform_private.__maint_meta_digest(scope_tables);
+  IF v_meta_after IS DISTINCT FROM v_meta_before THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'post:functions_acl_policies_changed'; END IF;
+  INSERT INTO platform_private.chain_purge_maintenance_ledger(purge_key,step,detail)
+  VALUES (k,'committed',jsonb_build_object('deleted',19,'triggers_restored',true,'out_of_scope_invariant',true,'meta_invariant',true));
+END $maint$;
+DROP FUNCTION platform_private.__maint_rows_digest(text);
+DROP FUNCTION platform_private.__maint_meta_digest(text[]);
+DO $z$ BEGIN
+  IF to_regprocedure('platform_private.__maint_rows_digest(text)') IS NOT NULL OR to_regprocedure('platform_private.__maint_meta_digest(text[])') IS NOT NULL
+     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
+                 WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgenabled <> 'O'
+                   AND c.relname IN ('entrega_checklist','entrega_comprovantes','entrega_termos','entregas','estoque_movimentacoes',
+                     'estoque_produto','envase','controle_qualidade','lotes','programacao_producao','ordens_servico')) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'post:helpers_or_triggers_not_restored'; END IF;
+END $z$;
+COMMIT;

+"""Seção RPC/ACL do produto e fechamento do catálogo global (reaproveitada da v1, sem alteração semântica)."""
+# v2.1: modo do ator LIVE corrigido ('read' inexistente no corpo capturado -> 'read_catalog').
+
+
+def lit(s): return "'" + s.replace("'", "''") + "'"
+
+
+def rpc_sql(w, EDITABLE, GLOBAL_FUNCS):
+    # 10. RPCs
+    fields = ", ".join(lit(k) for k in EDITABLE)
+    assigns = ",\n      ".join(
+        f"{k} = CASE WHEN p_payload ? '{k}' THEN v_in.{k} ELSE {k} END" for k, v in EDITABLE.items())
+    cols = ", ".join(EDITABLE)
+    # valores TIPADOS pela linha real (enum tipo_produto etc.); omitidos usam default seguro explícito
+    #   b2b_enabled omitido = false (o default LIVE da coluna é true: criação nunca libera B2B implicitamente)
+    SAFE_DEFAULT = {"b2b_enabled": "false", "e_insumo": "false", "estoque_minimo": "0"}
+    vals = ", ".join(f"CASE WHEN p_payload ? '{k}' THEN v_in.{k} ELSE {SAFE_DEFAULT.get(k, 'NULL')} END" for k in EDITABLE)
+    w(f"""CREATE TABLE public.tenant_product_receipts(
+  actor_id uuid NOT NULL, organization_id uuid NOT NULL, idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL, payload_hash text NOT NULL,
+  product_id uuid NOT NULL, result jsonb NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (actor_id, organization_id, idempotency_key));
+CREATE TABLE public.tenant_product_audit(
+  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, organization_id uuid NOT NULL, product_id uuid NOT NULL, actor_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  action text NOT NULL, before_state jsonb, after_state jsonb NOT NULL, at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());
+REVOKE ALL ON public.tenant_product_receipts, public.tenant_product_audit FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT ALL ON public.tenant_product_receipts, public.tenant_product_audit TO service_role;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.tenant_product_audit TO authenticated;
+ALTER TABLE public.tenant_product_receipts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.tenant_product_audit ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY tenant_product_audit_select ON public.tenant_product_audit FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (organization_id = platform_private.tenant_catalog_read_org());
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.tenant_product_audit_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_audit_immutable' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END $f$;
+CREATE TRIGGER a00_tenant_product_audit_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.tenant_product_audit
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION platform_private.tenant_product_audit_immutable();
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.tenant_product_validate(p_payload jsonb, p_create boolean) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+DECLARE k text; v_num numeric;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload) <> 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_payload_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  FOR k IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) LOOP
+    IF NOT k = ANY (ARRAY[{fields}]) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_field_forbidden:%', k USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF p_create AND NOT p_payload ? 'nome' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_nome_required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  IF p_create AND (NOT p_payload ? 'tipo' OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'tipo') <> 'string') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_tipo_required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  IF p_payload ? 'tipo' AND jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'tipo') <> 'string' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_tipo_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  IF p_payload ? 'b2b_enabled' AND jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'b2b_enabled') <> 'boolean' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_boolean_invalid:b2b_enabled' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  IF p_payload ? 'nome' AND (jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'nome') <> 'string' OR char_length(btrim(p_payload->>'nome')) NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 200) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_nome_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  FOREACH k IN ARRAY ARRAY['dose_ml_ha','estoque_minimo','valor_dose_brl','valor_ha_brl','valor_litro_brl'] LOOP
+    IF p_payload ? k AND jsonb_typeof(p_payload->k) <> 'null' THEN
+      IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->k) <> 'number' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_number_invalid:%', k USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+      v_num := (p_payload->>k)::numeric;
+      IF v_num < 0 OR v_num > 1e12 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_number_out_of_range:%', k USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  FOREACH k IN ARRAY ARRAY['e_insumo','b2b_enabled'] LOOP
+    IF p_payload ? k AND jsonb_typeof(p_payload->k) NOT IN ('boolean','null') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_boolean_invalid:%', k USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+END $f$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_product_save(p_product_id uuid, p_payload jsonb, p_expected_updated_at timestamptz, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_org2 uuid; v_hash text; v_rc public.tenant_product_receipts%ROWTYPE;
+  v_prev public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_new public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_in public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_res jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate');          -- tenant derivado do servidor
+  IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_key_required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  PERFORM platform_private.tenant_product_validate(p_payload, p_product_id IS NULL);
+  v_in := jsonb_populate_record(NULL::public.produtos, p_payload);   -- enum inválido => 22P02
+  v_hash := md5(concat_ws('|', coalesce(p_product_id::text,'new'), p_payload::text, coalesce(p_expected_updated_at::text,'')));
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws(':','tpk',v_uid,v_org,p_idempotency_key),0));
+  SELECT * INTO v_rc FROM public.tenant_product_receipts WHERE actor_id=v_uid AND organization_id=v_org AND idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF v_rc.payload_hash <> v_hash THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_idempotency_conflict' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+    RETURN v_rc.result || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
+  END IF;
+  IF p_product_id IS NULL THEN
+    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws(':','tpn',v_org,lower(btrim(p_payload->>'nome'))),0));
+    v_org2 := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate');         -- reautoriza após espera
+    IF v_org2 IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_scope_changed' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos WHERE owner_organization_id=v_org AND lower(btrim(nome))=lower(btrim(p_payload->>'nome'))) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_duplicate_name' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    INSERT INTO public.produtos(id, owner_organization_id, ativo, {cols})
+      VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), v_org, true, {vals}) RETURNING * INTO v_new;
+    INSERT INTO public.tenant_product_audit(organization_id, product_id, actor_id, action, before_state, after_state)
+      VALUES (v_org, v_new.id, v_uid, 'create', NULL, to_jsonb(v_new));
+  ELSE
+    IF p_expected_updated_at IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_cas_required' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    SELECT * INTO v_prev FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_product_id AND owner_organization_id=v_org FOR UPDATE;
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_not_found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
+    v_org2 := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate');           -- reautoriza após lock
+    IF v_org2 IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_scope_changed' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+    IF v_prev.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_version_conflict' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    IF p_payload ? 'nome' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos WHERE owner_organization_id=v_org AND id<>p_product_id
+         AND lower(btrim(nome))=lower(btrim(p_payload->>'nome'))) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_duplicate_name' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    UPDATE public.produtos SET
+      {assigns},
+      updated_at = clock_timestamp()
+     WHERE id=p_product_id AND owner_organization_id=v_org AND updated_at = p_expected_updated_at
+     RETURNING * INTO v_new;
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_version_conflict' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    INSERT INTO public.tenant_product_audit(organization_id, product_id, actor_id, action, before_state, after_state)
+      VALUES (v_org, v_new.id, v_uid, 'update', to_jsonb(v_prev), to_jsonb(v_new));
+  END IF;
+  v_res := jsonb_build_object('product_id', v_new.id, 'organization_id', v_org, 'updated_at', v_new.updated_at, 'replayed', false);
+  INSERT INTO public.tenant_product_receipts VALUES (v_uid, v_org, p_idempotency_key, v_hash, v_new.id, v_res, now());
+  RETURN v_res;
+END $f$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_product_set_archived(p_product_id uuid, p_archived boolean, p_expected_updated_at timestamptz, p_idempotency_key uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_org2 uuid; v_hash text; v_rc public.tenant_product_receipts%ROWTYPE;
+  v_prev public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_new public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_res jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate');
+  IF p_product_id IS NULL OR p_archived IS NULL OR p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR p_expected_updated_at IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_payload_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  v_hash := md5(concat_ws('|','archive',p_product_id,p_archived,p_expected_updated_at));
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws(':','tpk',v_uid,v_org,p_idempotency_key),0));
+  SELECT * INTO v_rc FROM public.tenant_product_receipts WHERE actor_id=v_uid AND organization_id=v_org AND idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF v_rc.payload_hash <> v_hash THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_idempotency_conflict' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+    RETURN v_rc.result || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
+  END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO v_prev FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_product_id AND owner_organization_id=v_org FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_not_found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
+  v_org2 := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('mutate');
+  IF v_org2 IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_scope_changed' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF v_prev.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_version_conflict' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  IF (v_prev.ativo IS NOT TRUE) = p_archived THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_no_change' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  UPDATE public.produtos SET ativo = NOT p_archived, updated_at = clock_timestamp()
+   WHERE id=p_product_id AND owner_organization_id=v_org AND updated_at=p_expected_updated_at RETURNING * INTO v_new;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_product_version_conflict' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+  INSERT INTO public.tenant_product_audit(organization_id, product_id, actor_id, action, before_state, after_state)
+    VALUES (v_org, v_new.id, v_uid, CASE WHEN p_archived THEN 'archive' ELSE 'unarchive' END, to_jsonb(v_prev), to_jsonb(v_new));
+  v_res := jsonb_build_object('product_id', v_new.id, 'ativo', v_new.ativo, 'updated_at', v_new.updated_at, 'replayed', false);
+  INSERT INTO public.tenant_product_receipts VALUES (v_uid, v_org, p_idempotency_key, v_hash, v_new.id, v_res, now());
+  RETURN v_res;
+END $f$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_product_list(p_include_archived boolean DEFAULT false)
+RETURNS SETOF public.produtos LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v_org uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('read_catalog');
+  RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM public.produtos WHERE owner_organization_id = v_org AND (p_include_archived OR ativo IS TRUE) ORDER BY nome;
+END $f$;
+DO $acl$ DECLARE f text; BEGIN
+  FOREACH f IN ARRAY ARRAY['public.tenant_product_save(uuid,jsonb,timestamptz,uuid)','public.tenant_product_set_archived(uuid,boolean,timestamptz,uuid)',
+                           'public.tenant_product_list(boolean)'] LOOP
+    EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role', f);
+    EXECUTE format('GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %s TO authenticated', f);
+  END LOOP;
+  FOREACH f IN ARRAY ARRAY['platform_private.tenant_product_validate(jsonb,boolean)','platform_private.catalog_owner_immutable()',
+                           'platform_private.tenant_product_audit_immutable()'] LOOP
+    EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role', f);
+  END LOOP;
+END $acl$;""")
+    # 11. catálogo global fechado no servidor
+    names = ", ".join(lit(n) for n in GLOBAL_FUNCS)
+    w(f"""DO $g$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN
+  FOR r IN SELECT p.oid::regprocedure AS sig FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
+            WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','platform_private') AND p.proname IN ({names}) LOOP
+    EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role', r.sig);
+    INSERT INTO platform_private.tenant_catalog_migration_ledger(step, detail) VALUES ('global_function_closed', jsonb_build_object('sig', r.sig::text));
+  END LOOP;
+END $g$;""")
+    # 11b. v2.6 — reescrita das 2 escritoras REWRITE_TENANT_WRITER (corpos LIVE pinados pelo PRE; drift aborta antes)
+    #   * associação micro→produto (DECISÃO HUMANA 02/11): preserva a permissão EXISTENTE do Financeiro SOMENTE nesta
+    #     operação e na própria empresa. Autorização específica catalog_fiscal_association_actor(): mesma identidade/
+    #     tenant/feature canônicos de catalog_tenant_actor (modo read_management: JWT, Superadmin negado, empresa ativa,
+    #     feature catalogo_precos) + papel administrador/gestor/financeiro. Financeiro NÃO ganha 'mutate' (CRUD geral).
+    #     Micro e produto do MESMO tenant, locks e reautorização após as esperas.
+    #   * sincronização de preço: mantém a lógica LIVE; aborta se algum volume ligado ao alvo pertencer a outro tenant.
+    w("""CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_fiscal_association_actor() RETURNS uuid
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
+BEGIN
+  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('read_management');         -- JWT/SA/empresa ativa/feature canônicos
+  IF NOT (platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'administrador'::public.app_role)
+          OR platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'gestor'::public.app_role)
+          OR platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'financeiro'::public.app_role)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_fiscal_association_role_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN v_org;
+END $f$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_fiscal_association_actor() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_associate_microorganism_fiscal_product(p_microorganism_id uuid, p_product_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
+ RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, product_id uuid) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $f$
+DECLARE v_org uuid; v_org2 uuid; v_m uuid; v_p uuid;
+BEGIN
+  v_org := platform_private.catalog_fiscal_association_actor();             -- autorização específica desta operação
+  IF p_microorganism_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
+  SELECT m.owner_organization_id INTO v_m FROM public.microrganismos m WHERE m.id = p_microorganism_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND OR v_m IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
+  IF p_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT p.owner_organization_id INTO v_p FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id = p_product_id FOR SHARE;
+    IF NOT FOUND OR v_p IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'product_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
+  END IF;
+  v_org2 := platform_private.catalog_fiscal_association_actor();            -- reautoriza após as esperas (READ COMMITTED)
+  IF v_org2 IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_actor_changed' USING ERRCODE = '40001'; END IF;
+  RETURN QUERY UPDATE public.microrganismos m SET product_id = p_product_id
+                WHERE m.id = p_microorganism_id AND m.owner_organization_id = v_org RETURNING m.id, m.product_id;
+END $f$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.rpc_associate_microorganism_fiscal_product(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.rpc_associate_microorganism_fiscal_product(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_catalogo_sync_mestre_preco(p_produto_id uuid, p_microrganismo_id uuid)
+ RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_litro numeric;
+  v_tiers integer;
+  v_owner uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF num_nonnulls(p_produto_id, p_microrganismo_id) <> 1 THEN RETURN; END IF;
+  IF p_produto_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT p.owner_organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id = p_produto_id;
+  ELSE
+    SELECT m.owner_organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.microrganismos m WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_owner IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.catalogo_volumes v
+              WHERE (v.produto_id = p_produto_id OR v.microrganismo_id = p_microrganismo_id)
+                AND v.owner_organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_owner) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_chain_divergence:catalogo_volumes' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT litro, tiers INTO v_litro, v_tiers
+  FROM public.fn_catalogo_litro_canonico(p_produto_id, p_microrganismo_id);
+
+  IF COALESCE(v_tiers,0) = 0 THEN
+    RETURN; -- sem apresentacao ativa: preserva fallback legado
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('arbio.catalogo_sync', 'on', true);
+
+  IF p_produto_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    IF v_tiers = 1 AND COALESCE(v_litro,0) > 0 THEN
+      UPDATE public.produtos p
+         SET valor_litro_brl = v_litro,
+             valor_dose_brl  = round(v_litro / 10.0, 2),
+             valor_ha_brl    = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.dose_ml_ha,0) > 0
+                                    THEN round(v_litro * (p.dose_ml_ha / 1000.0), 2) END
+       WHERE p.id = p_produto_id AND p.owner_organization_id = v_owner
+         AND (p.valor_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM v_litro
+              OR p.valor_dose_brl IS DISTINCT FROM round(v_litro / 10.0, 2));
+    ELSE
+      UPDATE public.produtos p
+         SET valor_litro_brl = NULL, valor_dose_brl = NULL, valor_ha_brl = NULL
+       WHERE p.id = p_produto_id AND p.owner_organization_id = v_owner
+         AND (p.valor_litro_brl IS NOT NULL OR p.valor_dose_brl IS NOT NULL OR p.valor_ha_brl IS NOT NULL);
+    END IF;
+  ELSE
+    IF v_tiers = 1 AND COALESCE(v_litro,0) > 0 THEN
+      UPDATE public.microrganismos m
+         SET valor_litro_brl = v_litro,
+             valor_dose_brl  = round(v_litro / 10.0, 2)
+       WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id AND m.owner_organization_id = v_owner
+         AND (m.valor_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM v_litro
+              OR m.valor_dose_brl IS DISTINCT FROM round(v_litro / 10.0, 2));
+    ELSE
+      UPDATE public.microrganismos m
+         SET valor_litro_brl = NULL, valor_dose_brl = NULL
+       WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id AND m.owner_organization_id = v_owner
+         AND (m.valor_litro_brl IS NOT NULL OR m.valor_dose_brl IS NOT NULL);

+              f"{counts(pg, db)}|" + pg.sql(f"SELECT count(*) FROM public.entrega_termos WHERE id='{EN}';", db))
+        db = fresh(f"SET session_replication_role=replica; INSERT INTO public.entrega_termos(entrega_id) VALUES ('{EN}');")
+        r = pg.sql(MAINT, db, ok=False)
+        check("CP-67", "termo vinculado à entrega (gatilho real 83º): dependência externa aborta", True, "external_dependency:entrega_termos.entrega_id" in r and counts(pg, db) == "19")
+        code = "\n".join(l.split("--")[0] for l in MAINT.splitlines())
+        bad = code.count("DISABLE TRIGGER ALL") + code.count("DISABLE TRIGGER USER") + MAINT.count("session_replication_role =") + code.upper().count("CASCADE") + code.count("set_config(")
+        check("CP-38", "estático: sem DISABLE TRIGGER ALL, replication_role, CASCADE ou GUC", 0, bad)
+    finally:
+        pg.stop()
+        summ = {"PASS": sum(c["status"] == "PASS" for c in checks), "FAIL": sum(c["status"] == "FAIL" for c in checks)}
+        (OUT / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps({"summary": summ, "checks": checks}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
+        print(json.dumps(summ))
+
+
+main()
